text:
Maya: Hey team — need a compact creative mini-kit for next week's LLM Cost & Latency webinar. Things we need: social hero (IG/Twitter/LinkedIn sizes), email header, a landing hero (1200x600), and a 3-slide 'benchmark snapshot' PNG pack. Deadline: Wed EOD.
Liam: Quick Q — primary goal is LP conversions + webinar signups, right? or just post-event downloads?
Maya: Primary = webinar signups and LP conversions. Post-event download is secondary. Keep CTAs focused (Register / Watch).
Arjun: For the 3-slide snapshot, can you confirm data points? I can write micro-copy.
Maya: Snapshot should show: 1) median latency vs open baseline, 2) cost per 1k tokens with batching, 3) qualitative note on quality tradeoff (1 short sentence). I'll drop raw numbers in a minute.
Sofia: Brand note — use primary palette (brand-blue, graphite, ash). Avoid bright neon accents. Use our updated H1 font weights from the brand kit (link below). Also include the small compliance footer for dedicated/private mentions.
Maya: Figma starter file: https://figma.com/file/xxxx/mini-kit-starter (placeholder). Naming conv:
```
folder: /marketing/webinar/2025-llm-cost-mini-kit/
files: 1200x600_landing_hero_v1.png
files: social_1080x1080_v1.png
files: email_header_600x200_v1.png
files: benchmark_slide_1_v1.png
```
Maya: @Sofia can you run a quick brand check and flag anything that needs legal review?
Sofia: Will do. Also request 2 variants for hero copy: short (6-8 words) + longer tagline (12-15 words) for A/B.
Arjun: I'll draft 4 headline variants and 4 sublines by EOD tomorrow. Put them in the figma text layer so designers can copy.
DesignBot: system — Design system v3 templates applied to file. 3 hero layouts scaffolded.
Liam: Inbound routing — please add UTM templates: utm_source=organic_social, utm_medium=webinar, utm_campaign=llm-cost-0325. Also we need two CTA URLs for A/B: /register?cta=A and /register?cta=B.
Maya: Good call. Include tracking pixel note in the email header asset README.
Sofia: For accessibility — ensure 4.5:1 contrast on hero CTAs, and provide alt text suggestions for social images.
Maya: Deliverable checklist for design: 1) 3 social sizes (1080x1080, 1200x628, 1080x1920) 2) landing hero 1200x600 3) email header 600x200 4) 3 benchmark slides PNG + source fig 5) README with UTM, copy variants, alt text, and font/brand notes.
Liam: Do we need any localized versions?
Maya: Not for launch. If the webinar drives >1k signups in region X we'll iterate.
Arjun: Will add copy variants + alt text to the figma by EOD tomorrow.
Sofia: Brand check done — flagged two items: replace neon gradient on slide 2, and update H1 weight. No legal flags.
Maya: Awesome. Who's taking design?
Liam: @Maya are you owning the handoff to design ops or do you want design team to pick it up?
Maya: I'll own handoff. @Design team — can someone pick this up with a Tues midday-ish rough? We need final Wed EOD.
DesignBot: reminder — please add "project: webinar-mini-kit" tag to the figma file to enable QA pipeline.
DesignBot: preview generation queued — will post screenshots in thread when ready.
Maya: Thanks all — small, focused kit. Ping here if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
